summary: Frontend-only verification of Landlord & Facilities Management roles + 'More' menu + 6 shared placeholder pages. All 12 requested flows PASS. Signup for landlord/facilities routes correctly to their dashboards which render the specified badge/stat cards/mock sites. Sidebar contains 'sidebar-nav-more' for every role tested (customer, landlord, facilities). Switch-account dialog exposes all 6 role buttons and correctly navigates to /landlord/dashboard and /facilities/dashboard. Cost Estimator loads from GET /api/cost-guide with 10 category options in filter dropdown. Community Forum, Legal & Privacy (6 PDF download buttons), Guide & Help (channels + FAQs), Report Provider (form with 4 fields), My Disputes (empty state) all render correctly. Existing customer signup regression also passes.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking a role button (e.g. switch-role-facilities), navigation occurs but the dialog is not closed programmatically. The DialogOverlay lingers on the new page and intercepts pointer events until the user manually dismisses (Escape / close X). Automated first click on sidebar-nav-more right after switch was blocked by overlay for 30s.

action_items: In Sidebar.jsx handleSwitchRole, close the Dialog before/after navigate (e.g. control open state via useState and set to false, or wrap DialogTrigger with a controlled Dialog). This prevents the overlay from blocking clicks after switching roles.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx line ~133: handleSwitchRole does not close the switch-role Dialog after navigation, leaving the overlay in the DOM and blocking interactions until manual dismissal.
Signup.jsx uses localStorage('dispatchr_selected_role') to preselect role - fine, but not cleared after signup so a returning user may see stale preselection.
MoreMenu still exposes Notifications/Settings tiles that route to non-existent pages (per problem statement, these are acknowledged placeholders).
test_credentials: Created on the fly: test-ll-{ts}@dispatchr.test / password123 (landlord), test-cust-{ts}@dispatchr.test (customer). Cookie-based httpOnly auth confirmed working via withCredentials.
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond test users created during signup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows verified passing on preview URL. Only follow-up needed is the minor 'switch role dialog does not auto-close' UX polish. Notifications/Settings 404 is expected and out of scope.
